name: Dumbbell Incline Alternating Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie back with feet planted flat.
Hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder with palms facing forward and shoulder blades anchored.
Press one dumbbell straight above your shoulder while holding the other steady at chest level.
Lower the pressed dumbbell under control back to your shoulder and alternate arms.
tips: Keep both shoulder blades against the bench without letting your torso twist.
Keep each wrist stacked over its elbow and brace your core throughout.
